name: Ulises Francisco Espaillat
contribution: A 19th-century Dominican Republic liberal statesman and author.

checks.lead: Ulises Francisco Espaillat Quiñones (February 9, 1823 – April 25, 1878) was a 19th-century Dominican Republic liberal statesman and author.  He served as president of the Dominican Republic from April 29, 1876, to October 5, 1876. Espaillat Province is named after him.
